{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import threading, time, requests, uvicorn
from backend.server import app

def run_srv():
    uvicorn.run(app, host='127.0.0.1', port=8888, log_level='error')

t = threading.Thread(target=run_srv, daemon=True)
t.start()
time.sleep(2.0)

# Probe endpoints
r_root = requests.get('http://127.0.0.1:8888/')
print('Root endpoint status:', r_root.status_code, 'Content length:', len(r_root.text))

r_status = requests.get('http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/status')
print('API status:', r_status.status_code, r_status.json())

r_scan = requests.get('http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/scan')
print('API scan status:', r_scan.status_code, 'Total procs:', r_scan.json()['total_processes'])

print('All server endpoints verified working successfully!')
"","WaitMsBeforeAsync":8000,"toolSummary":"Probe server in-process and verify endpoints"}
